bodyLines: AI transforms the economy while eroding the profits of businesses we own today.
I research where those profits move next and how to invest through the transition.

framework.eyebrow: The next decade · Where to look
framework.heading: Four ways value moves

items.label: Substitute
items.question: Which profits are at risk?
bodyLines: AI competes with businesses paid to think or coordinate.
The risk is owning the work that becomes cheap to copy.

items.label: Amplify
items.question: What does cheap intelligence need?
bodyLines: More AI use needs more power, machines and verification.
I look for suppliers that retain pricing power as use grows.

items.label: Reprice
items.question: What cannot be made abundant?
bodyLines: Land, rights, attention and scarce monetary assets remain
limited. I look for owners that capture the extra value.

items.label: Unlock
items.question: What becomes a viable business?
bodyLines: Cheaper cognition makes new services and markets viable.
The next generation of companies emerges in these markets.

cycle.eyebrow: The AI capital cycle · Reviewed quarterly
cycle.heading: Every technology boom borrows from the future
cycle.body: Capital finances the buildout before its returns are proven. I track that gap to judge when to add exposure, wait or cut risk.
cycle.imageAlt: An unfinished bridge above a river gorge, with construction on the near bank and a sunlit city across the missing span.
